text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Surveillance systémique au DETEC", "gist": "The text is about systemic safety surveillance at DETEC"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DETEC", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Safety Office", "gist": "The office responsible for safety surveillance at DETEC"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le Safety Office voit la surveillance de la sécurité au DETEC comme un système global qui tient compte des êtres humains, des technologies et des structures afin de garantir la sécurité (safety)", "gist": "The Safety Office considers safety surveillance at DETEC as a global system accounting for humans, technologies, and structures to ensure safety"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "le Safety Office échange régulièrement avec des services internes et externes afin d’identifier les sujets à aborder", "gist": "The Safety Office regularly exchanges with internal and external services to identify topics to address"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "il développe des solutions novatrices", "gist": "It develops innovative solutions"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "analyse les résultats sur la base d’objectifs", "gist": "It analyzes results based on objectives"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "adapte la surveillance de la sécurité du DETEC en fonction de sa vision", "gist": "It adapts DETEC's safety surveillance according to its vision"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "En tant que plate-forme de coordination, de conseil et de formation dans ce domaine, le Safety Office vise à renforcer la surveillance de la sécurité au DETEC", "gist": "As a coordination, advisory, and training platform in this field, the Safety Office aims to strengthen safety surveillance at DETEC"}]}
